headline: EMBERWOOD's vale is no longer a hall of mirrors
lede: Jon's iPhone caught the diorama rendering mirrored — press right, walk left. One session, one surgical fix: every view-space pixel now passes through a single X-flip, with gates that would have caught this on day one.

notes.text: Root cause was orthographic-camera geometry, not input code: up=(0,-1,0) on a +Z-up stage mirrors X. Fix = FX(x)=256-x applied to every view-space placement; two compensating sprite hacks deleted.

emberwoodcheck gains 4 orientation gates (east-right, north-top, world-east on hold-right, projected-screen-x). Mutation-proven: FX=identity reds exactly the horizontal gates with Jon's mirror signature — the mirror can't come back quietly.
Tilt-shift focus was pointed off-screen (focus passed -hero.y); blur no longer blankets the whole vale. One of the reasons town read muddy on phones.
